messages.text: Norris beats Antonelli with 'masterpiece' to take Spanish GP pole

metadata.summary: Lando Norris produced a stunning lap to beat Kimi Antonelli to the first pole position at Formula 1's all-new Madring circuit in a thrilling Spanish Grand Prix Qualifying.
metadata.content: Spanish GP: Lando Norris beats Kimi Antonelli to first pole position at Madring after thrilling qualifying finale | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to content Spanish GP: Lando Norris beats Kimi Antonelli to first pole position at Madring after thrilling qualifying finale Lando Norris edges Kimi Antonelli by 11 thousandths of a second to claim first Madring pole; Max Verstappen beats Lewis Hamilton to third; watch the Spanish Grand Prix from the all-new Madring circuit live on Sky Sports F1 at 2pm on Sunday, with build-up from 12.30pm Saturday 12 September 2026 17:19, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights from qualifying for the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix. Lando Norris produced a stunning lap to beat Kimi Antonelli to the first pole position at Formula 1's all-new Madring circuit in a thrilling Spanish Grand Prix Qualifying. The McLaren driver hadn't appeared to be in contention for pole at any point of the session, but found a huge amount of pace on his final run to edge out championship leader Antonelli by 11 thousandths of a second. Max Verstappen, who had surged into pole contention earlier in the session, edged out Lewis Hamilton for third after the Ferrari driver produced a strong recovery having crashed in final practice earlier on Saturday. metadata.summary: Mercedes chief Toto Wolff has dismissed suggestions from "couch warriors" that the Silver Arrows failed to treat George Russell fairly during the Italian Grand Prix.
metadata.content: Mercedes chief Toto Wolff fumes at 'couch warriors' questioning team's treatment of George Russell in title battle with Kimi Antonelli | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to content Exclusive Mercedes chief Toto Wolff fumes at 'couch warriors' questioning team's treatment of George Russell in title battle with Kimi Antonelli George Russell was beaten by his Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli in the Italian Grand Prix after the pair were put on different strategies; watch the Spanish Grand Prix from the all-new Madring circuit live on Sky Sports F1 at 2pm on Sunday, with build-up from 12.30pm Saturday 12 September 2026 16:12, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Toto Wolff reveals Mercedes team orders strategy. Mercedes chief Toto Wolff has dismissed suggestions from "couch warriors" that the Silver Arrows failed to treat George Russell fairly during the Italian Grand Prix. Russell was narrowly leading the race from his team-mate Kimi Antonelli when Mercedes took a decision to pit the Italian under a virtual safety car. The call ultimately benefitted Antonelli as he used his fresh tyres to pull off a stunning victory having started from 19th on the grid, which increased Russell's deficit to the Italian at the top of the standings to 66 points.
